original_agent_description: Node-aware signoff ECO agent. Sits between signoff STA rung-1 and a rung-2 reopen: clusters violating paths to find the root-cause fix sites, judges whether a targeted ECO can close the gate or whether the miss is structural, and then drives bounded, checkpointed, REVERSIBLE repair waves by steering OpenROAD repair_timing / repair_design under scoped set_dont_touch. Encapsulates fill removal, incremental routing, PDN via repair, extraction and STA refresh so the blast radius stays inside the stage. Escalates to rung-2 on plateau. Emits a Common Design Envelope. Validated on SkyWater sky130.

parameter_descriptions.params_json:
CONTRACT: one single-line JSON object (double quotes) with a top-level "scenario" (one of: analyze_violations, eco_wave). Object params such as pdk_binding / deck_vars are inline JSON objects, e.g. "pdk_binding":{"pdk":"nangate45","liberty":["/input/cells.lib"]}. Params named rtl/upf/sdc/text carry inline text; file paths go in *_file(s)/sources/netlist/def/gds keys as absolute /input/... paths. On failure read the envelope `error` field. JSON with scenario `analyze_violations` or `eco_wave`.
`analyze_violations` (pure analysis, mutates nothing -- ALWAYS run this first): provide `sta_report` (OpenSTA report_checks text), optional `clock_period_ns`, `total_endpoints`, `path_type` (max|min), `top`, and `frozen_prefixes`.
`frozen_prefixes` lists hierarchy scopes this level may NOT modify -- hardened macro instances, the pad/IO ring, vendor hard IP. Supply it whenever macros are integrated TIMING-TRANSPARENTLY (top-level STA reads the macro's routed netlist + SPEF because no Liberty abstraction exists), because then macro-INTERNAL instances appear in the top-level timing report and would otherwise rank as the highest-leverage fix -- which is exactly the edit that invalidates that macro's closed signoff. Matching is on a hierarchy boundary, so `u_<myDesign-A>` freezes `u_<myDesign-A>/_hot_` but not `u_<myDesign-A>_shim/_g_`. Frozen instances are moved to `frozen_candidates` (kept, never dropped -- a dominant frozen cluster is the evidence for escalating to that block's own flow).
Returns ranked fix candidates by `leverage` (dominance / perturbation), the concentration ratio, and an entry screen whose verdict is `hard_reject` (escalate to a rung-2 reopen, do NOT run a wave) or `assess`. Entry thresholds are PROVISIONAL priors, flagged as such in the envelope, and pending calibration.
`eco_wave` (executes ONE wave): provide `top`, `def_file`, `sdc`, `baseline_sta_report` (plus optional `baseline_drv_report`, `baseline_route_drc_report` and `baseline_clock_skew_report`: a class whose BEFORE is unmeasured can never be shown to have improved, so without these a DRV-only, DRC-only or clock-tree-balance change is invisible to the commit rule and the wave rolls back; their absence is reported as a named judgement gap) (REQUIRED -- without it the wave cannot be judged and the tool fails closed), `liberty`/`tech_lef`/`cell_lef` (or `pdk_binding`), optional `spef`, `rc_rules`, `corner_name`, `clock_period_ns`, `wave_index`, `target_instances` (the cluster to scope the repair to; everything else is frozen with set_dont_touch), `dont_touch`, `repair_classes` (default ["drv_pre","setup","hold","drv"]; may also include `resize` for agent-directed cell swaps, or `buffer` for agent-directed buffer insertion), `buffer_insertions` (list of {"net":..., "buffer_cell":..., "load_pins":[...], "purpose": fanout|hold|load_isolation, optional "location":[x,y]} applied by the `buffer` class. Serves BOTH fanout splitting -- move a subset of a net's loads behind a new buffer to drop the driver below max_fanout -- and HOLD PADDING, interposing a buffer to add delay on a too-fast path; `purpose` is recorded because the mechanics are identical and intent cannot be read off the netlist. Validated in a read-only pass BEFORE any mutation: the net must exist and every load pin must already be ON that net, because OpenROAD ACCEPTS both errors and silently rewires the pin. On a CLOCK net the cell must come from `clock_buffer_cells` (caller or PDK binding; never defaulted) -- a data buffer is not characterised for the balanced rise/fall CTS built the tree on. Clock-ness is the union of the OpenDB signal type and OpenSTA clock propagation, so a DEF that does not annotate clock nets is still classified correctly), `clock_buffer_cells`, `resize_swaps` (list of {"instance":..., "to_cell":...} applied by the `resize` class -- each swap is PROVEN to be in the current cell's report_equiv_cells set in a read-only pass BEFORE any mutation, and a swap that is not equivalent aborts the wave; the target cell is caller-supplied because report_equiv_cells reports only Area and Leakage and carries NO drive-strength column, and sky130 cell names do not encode drive reliably either -- inv_1 and inv_2 have identical area. Supplying swaps without the `resize` class, or the class without swaps, is rejected rather than run as a no-op), `repair_tns` (0-100 batch breadth; defaults to 0 = worst endpoint only, NOT OpenROAD's own default of 100), `max_repairs_per_pass`, `aggression` (conservative|moderate|aggressive), `setup_margin_ns`, `hold_margin_ns`, `max_utilization`, `max_buffer_percent`, `max_wire_length_um`, `max_displacement`, `filler_cells`, `repair_pdn_vias` (default true), `pdn_via_repair_layer`, `power_net`/`ground_net` (default VDD/VSS), `wire_rc_layer`, `max_paths` (default 200), `timeout_s` (default 7200), `doctrine_deviation_justification`.
The wave is checkpointed and REVERSIBLE: if it regresses any previously-clean check -- setup, hold, DRV, routing DRC or power-grid connectivity -- or fails to improve total negative slack, it is rolled back, `signoff_evidence.eco_def` points at a copy of the untouched input, and the mutated artifacts are renamed with a `.rejected` suffix so no downstream glob can consume them. Artifacts are wave-indexed. When SPEF is supplied it is READ and never overwritten by a placement estimate; parasitics are RE-EXTRACTED after the repair so the verdict reflects post-ECO RC. `-allow_setup_violations` is never passed. Minimum pulse width, minimum period and crosstalk noise have NO repair engine in OpenROAD and are reported `measurement: "unavailable"` -- detect-only, never a silent clean. Double-quoted JSON only.
